flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:9090/settings/general then If a login form is shown @v16:"Log in with username {{global.ld_user}} and password {{secrets.user.ld_pass}}".
Go to http://localhost:9090/settings/general.
Look only at the tab bar inside the Settings page content (not the top navigation bar or its dropdown menus).
Verify that this in-page tab bar contains a tab labelled 'Admin'.

remark: analyze: a login form is shown
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Username"; type "Password"; click "Login"
wait: Waiting confirm successful login on the Settings page
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, "the in-page tab bar inside the Settings page content co
assert: the in-page tab bar inside the Settings page content contains a tab labelled 'Ad

summary:
The test expected an Admin tab after logging in with the provided user credentials, but the Settings page shown for that account has no in-page tab bar or Admin option. This indicates that the account does not have the required administrator access, or the test expectation was written for a different account.
Use credentials for an account with administrator access, or update the test to verify only the settings options available to this user.
one_liner: The run logged in successfully, but the supplied account does not show an Admin tab, so the role-dependent check could not pass.
